title: Edge backend egress policy response v2
description: GET /backend-egress-policy response for the immutable process policy, schema_version 2. Version 2 changes the meaning of public_only_guaranteed: it also requires enforcement_scope=local-data-plane. On a control plane (enforcement_scope=admission-only), Edge v0.9.14 adds the optional data_plane_attestation object within schema_version 2: the policies the namespace's connected data planes self-reported over ConfigSync Subscribe. JWT namespace authorization and Cache-Control: no-store are HTTP/runtime requirements. JSON conformance cannot establish authentication, serving DP identity or actual enforcement; the CP's own top-level fields are not DP attestation, and data_plane_attestation is a self-reported, point-in-time view, not cryptographic host attestation.

x-contract.name: backend-egress-policy
x-contract.edge_availability: Released in Ferrum Edge v0.9.13 at 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425 (ferrum-edge#6017; see issue #5994 and PR #5999). Edge v0.9.14 at 9bd4d5f9caa4ebe8f0ea13e76d8a6e2172eaca7d adds the optional, CP-only data_plane_attestation object (ferrum-edge#6029, issue #6020) without changing schema_version; v0.9.13 never emits it. Replaces v1, which Edge v0.9.11 and v0.9.12 emitted; v0.9.13 and v0.9.14 never emit schema_version 1.

provenance.note: Transcribed OpenAPI response shape. DataPlaneEgressAttestation is transcribed as one closed object (the owner's allOf of DataPlaneEgressSummary and the source/data_planes members with unevaluatedProperties: false). Additional cross-field assertions copy the handler's exact mode class lists, its v2 public-only guarantee calculation (local-data-plane, public mode, no allow overrides), the CP-only presence of data_plane_attestation, and the attestation rules of src/grpc/backend_egress_attestation.rs; no authorization or cryptographic validity is modeled as JSON validation.

schema_version 2, the local-enforcement guarantee rule and "Data-plane attestation on a control plane"; docs/cp_dp_mode.md "Backend egress policy attestation" and docs/upgrade_guide.md "Upgrading to 0.9.14" describe the ConfigSync report and its limits.

ip_classification.description: Versioned Edge private/reserved classifier; public is its complement. Exact v1 ranges, recognized IPv4 embeddings and global IETF exceptions are documented in the pinned owner admin_api.md. Response schema_version 2 keeps classifier v1.

namespace.description: Authorized request namespace; absent request header selects ferrum.

policy_scope.description: Process-wide immutable loaded policy; changing it requires a process restart.

enforcement_scope.description: local-data-plane serves this namespace; unserved-namespace serves another. admission-only is CP without a local proxy; no-data-plane includes node_agent. CP and non-serving metadata do not attest remote DP policy.

mode.description: Loaded mode; production default is both.

mode_allowed_ip_classes.description: Mode-stage classes only, after overlays and dangerous baseline; not unconditional effective allows.

mode_blocked_ip_classes.description: Mode-stage blocks; explicit allow CIDRs can bypass them.

dangerous_ranges_blocked.description: Loaded dangerous-range baseline, production default true. Explicit allows can bypass it; it permits ordinary loopback/RFC1918/ULA under both mode and alone does not certify public-only egress.

allow_cidr_overrides_present.description: Whether explicit allow CIDRs are loaded; addresses and counts are withheld.

deny_cidr_overrides_present.description: Whether explicit deny CIDRs are loaded; addresses and counts are withheld.

evaluation_order.description: First match for each address and recognized embedded IPv4 candidate. Ambiguous local-use NAT64 must pass both decoded candidates and the literal IPv6 policy.

public_only_guaranteed.description: True exactly when enforcement_scope=local-data-plane, mode=public and allow_cidr_overrides_present=false. Always false for admission-only, unserved-namespace and no-data-plane, which enforce nothing for the selected namespace. Deny overrides only restrict. It is not DNS validation, a connect test, or external firewall attestation.

data_plane_attestation.description: CP-only (enforcement_scope=admission-only), from Edge v0.9.14: every live ConfigSync Subscribe stream for the selected namespace with the policy it self-reported. Absent on every other response and on Edge v0.9.13. Additive within schema_version 2; the CP's own top-level fields keep their admission-only meaning.

DataPlaneEgressAttestation.description: DataPlaneEgressAttestation: DataPlaneEgressSummary plus source and data_planes. Streams are counted per stream, not per distinct node_id; another namespace's streams never appear. Disconnected data planes that still serve cached config are not listed, so compare connected_data_planes with the expected inventory. connected_data_planes equals reporting_data_planes plus unknown_data_planes and the length of data_planes; JSON Schema cannot express those sums.

connected_data_planes.description: Live ConfigSync Subscribe streams for the selected namespace, one per stream rather than per distinct node_id.

reporting_data_planes.description: Connected data planes that sent a recognised egress policy report.

unknown_data_planes.description: Connected data planes whose egress policy is unknown.

weakest_policy.description: Field-wise least restrictive combination of the reporting data planes' policies: the mode admitting the union of their mode-stage classes, dangerous_ranges_blocked only if every one blocks, allow overrides if any has them, deny overrides only if every one has them. Null exactly when no data plane reported; it omits unknown data planes.

weakest_policy_complete.description: True only when at least one data plane is connected and every connected data plane reported.

all_connected_public_only_guaranteed.description: True exactly when weakest_policy_complete is true and weakest_policy.public_only_guaranteed is true. False for an empty set or any unknown data plane; covers only data planes connected at the time of the read.

data_planes.description: Live streams for the selected namespace, sorted by node_id then connected_at.

DataPlaneEgressEntry.description: One live Subscribe stream (DataPlaneEgressEntry). No build version is included: the ConfigSync build gate pins it to the CP's own build, and GET /cluster reports it.

node_id.description: Authenticated ConfigSync node identity. Several streams may share one node_id.

connected_at.description: When the data plane's Subscribe stream was established.

policy.description: Policy the data plane reported; null when unknown.

DataPlaneEgressPolicy.description: Presence-only backend egress policy metadata a data plane reported (DataPlaneEgressPolicy). Field meanings match the same-named top-level fields for a local data plane; CIDRs, addresses and counts are withheld.

public_only_guaranteed.description: True exactly for mode=public with no allow CIDR overrides.
